nodes.label: Journey 02 — Spawn and converse
nodes.rationale: The product in one sentence: it exercises client, WebSocket, broker, shim socket and agent rather than any single link. Asserting the agent's reply ('Fixture reply: <prompt>') rather than the echo is the point — an echoed message only proves the client can draw its own text. Use a unique per-run prompt, since a fixed string passes against a stale transcript.
